start: Member app, Gym tab, a member of a gym that has Message your gym

steps.action: Tap "Message your gym", pick Question under "What is it about?", type, press "Send message"
user_sees: "Sent. When your gym replies, you will see it below."
"Not seen by your gym yet. Waiting for a reply."
must_not: The message sent twice
The message sent to a trainer when The gym was picked

steps.action: Wait until the desk opens Member messages
user_sees: "Seen by your gym. Waiting for a reply."
must_not: "Seen" before anyone at the gym opened it

steps.action: The gym replies
user_sees: A phone pop-up "Reply to your message: ..."
"Your gym replied. Tap to read it." on the Gym tab
Only the first name of who replied
must_not: The full name or role of the staff member
No pop-up while "Messages from my gym" is on

start: Member app, Message your gym, Feedback

steps.action: Pick Feedback, tick "Send without my name", type, send
user_sees: "Sent without your name" on the message
"Your gym can still reply here, but it will not see who sent it."
must_not: The member's name, phone or list id shown to anyone at the gym

start: Member app, Message your gym

steps.action: Pick Complaint and tick "Send without my name"
user_sees: "Only feedback can be sent without your name."
must_not: A complaint saved without the name

steps.action: Press "Send message" with an empty box
user_sees: "Please type your message first."
must_not: An empty message saved

steps.action: Send a sixth new message within 24 hours
user_sees: "You have sent a lot of messages today. Please try again tomorrow."
must_not: The sixth message saved

steps.action: Send while the gym is paused
user_sees: "Messages to your gym are paused for now. Please ask at the front desk."
must_not: A message saved to a paused gym

start: Member app, a message the gym replied to

steps.action: The gym marks it as done
user_sees: "Your gym marked this as done. Write back if you need more help."
must_not: The thread hidden from the member

steps.action: Write back
user_sees: The thread waits for the gym again
must_not: The new line lost because the thread was done

steps.action: Leave the gym
user_sees: The messages are gone
must_not: The gym still reading the member's messages after they left

start: Member app, Message your gym, before sending

steps.action: Pick Feedback, then Complaint, and read who reads it
user_sees: "The owner and front desk at {gym} read your feedback. Your trainers do not see it."
"Only the owner of {gym} reads your complaint. The front desk and trainers do not see it."
must_not: A trainer reading feedback or a complaint
MettleUp staff named as readers of gym feedback

start: Admin app as the owner, Member messages, one question waiting

steps.action: Open "Member messages"
user_sees: "Waiting for a reply" with the member's first name and "To: Gym owner"
must_not: A thread of a member who left the gym

steps.action: Type a reply and send it
user_sees: "Reply sent."
"The member has not opened your reply yet."
must_not: The reply saved twice
No pop-up queued for the member

steps.action: Press "Mark as done"
user_sees: "Marked as done by {name}... If the member writes again, it moves back to Waiting for a reply."
must_not: The thread deleted

start: Admin app as the owner, a new complaint

steps.action: Tap the bell line "{name} sent your gym a complaint. Open Member messages to read it."
user_sees: Member messages opens on the complaint
must_not: The complaint shown to the desk or trainers

start: Admin app as the owner, Member messages

steps.action: Reply to a thread of a member who just left the gym
user_sees: "This message is no longer here, so nothing was sent or changed. The member may have left the gym."
must_not: A reply saved for a member who left

steps.action: Send an empty reply
user_sees: "Please type a reply (up to ... letters)."
must_not: An empty reply saved

steps.action: Reply in a thread of 50 lines
user_sees: "This conversation is full. The member can send a new message."
must_not: A 51st line

start: Admin app as the owner, a thread marked done

steps.action: Press "Mark as not done"
user_sees: The thread back under Waiting for a reply
must_not: The done line still shown

steps.action: The member writes again in a done thread
user_sees: The thread back in Waiting for a reply
must_not: The new line hidden because the thread was done

start: Admin app as the owner, a feedback sent without the name

steps.action: Open the feedback
user_sees: "A member (name hidden)"
"The member sent this without their name. You can still reply here."
must_not: The member's name, phone, app id or list id anywhere on the page or in the alert

start: Admin app as front desk (not ticked Trainer), Member messages, a question to "Gym admin"

steps.action: Open "Member messages"
user_sees: The question under "Waiting for a reply" with "To: Gym admin"
must_not: A complaint sent only to the owner

steps.action: Reply and mark as done
user_sees: "Reply sent." then the done line with the desk person's first name
must_not: The owner's name as who replied

start: Admin app as front desk, a new feedback

steps.action: Tap the bell line "{name} sent your gym feedback. Open Member messages to read it."
user_sees: Member messages opens on the feedback
must_not: A bell line for a complaint sent only to the owner

start: Admin app as front desk, a complaint the member sent to the owner only

steps.action: Look for the complaint in Member messages
user_sees: No such thread
"Messages a member sent only to the owner or to a trainer are not shown here..."
must_not: The complaint listed or counted

steps.action: Reply to that thread by its address
user_sees: "This message is no longer here..."
must_not: A reply saved

start: Admin app as front desk, a feedback marked done by the owner

steps.action: Open the feedback
user_sees: The done line with the owner's name
must_not: The thread still under Waiting

steps.action: Press "Mark as not done"
user_sees: The thread back under Waiting
must_not: The owner's done record kept as well

start: Admin app as front desk, Member messages page

steps.action: Read the note at the top
user_sees: "Messages a member sent only to the owner or to a trainer are not shown here. Complaints show here only when the member picked "Gym admin"."
must_not: A complaint to the owner shown to the desk

start: Admin app as a ticked trainer, a question a member sent to this trainer

steps.action: Open "Member messages"
user_sees: The question with "To: {trainer name}"
must_not: Feedback or complaints listed
Questions sent to another trainer

steps.action: Reply
user_sees: "Reply sent."
must_not: The reply signed with another person's name

start: Admin app as a trainer, a new question to them

steps.action: Tap the bell line for the question
user_sees: Member messages opens on it
must_not: A bell line for feedback

start: Admin app as a trainer, a feedback exists at the gym

steps.action: Look for the feedback
user_sees: No Feedback button
"Feedback and complaints never go to trainers, so they are not shown here..."
must_not: The feedback listed, counted or alerted

steps.action: Reply to the feedback thread by its address
user_sees: "This message is no longer here..."
must_not: A reply saved

start: Admin app as a trainer, a question they answered

steps.action: Mark it as done, then the member writes again
user_sees: The question back under Waiting
must_not: The member's new line lost

start: Admin app as a trainer who is also the owner

steps.action: Open Member messages
user_sees: Feedback and complaints shown, because this person is the owner
must_not: The owner losing feedback because they are also ticked Trainer
